evals.prompt: Unsere Marketing-Seiten werden von Google kaum gefunden. Schau dir den Build in evals/fixtures/bad an, die Seite läuft unter https://example.com, und sag mir, woran es liegt.
evals.expected_output: Report in the template format with evidenced findings (file + line or script code), prioritised Blockers / High / Medium, concrete patches, and a verification section with before/after script exit codes.
expectations: Runs scripts/seo_check.py with --base-url instead of only reading templates
Names indexing blockers (canonical to localhost/staging, two canonicals, missing title/h1/viewport) before content topics
Flags the empty client-rendered index.html as the first finding
Uses exactly the report structure from assets/report-template.md
Delivers at least one concrete code patch with a file path
Mentions the FAQPage markup as retired under Not relevant, not as a fix

evals.prompt: Wir wollen in ChatGPT und den Google AI Overviews auftauchen. Brauchen wir eine llms.txt und mehr Schema-Markup?
evals.expected_output: Sober correction: llms.txt is not a Google signal, schema is not a prerequisite for AI features; instead indexability, snippet eligibility, non-commodity content, Bing index for ChatGPT, and the Search Console Generative AI report as the measurement.
expectations: Contradicts the premise instead of confirming it
States that Google does not read llms.txt and cites the Google AI optimisation guide
Explains that structured data is not required for AI features
Mentions that ChatGPT search retrieves via Bing and recommends Bing Webmaster Tools / IndexNow
Names the Search Console Generative AI performance report and that it shows impressions only
Does not promise a position or share of voice in AI answers

evals.prompt: Baue eine neue Landingpage für unser Bodenanalyse-Angebot unter /leistungen/bodenanalyse.
evals.expected_output: Skill triggers proactively: page is delivered with title, description, one h1, self-referencing canonical, Open Graph, BreadcrumbList JSON-LD and image attributes, then verified with seo_check.py exit 0.
expectations: Skill activates without an explicit SEO mention
Uses assets/page-launch-checklist.md
Generated page has exactly one h1
Metadata set: title, description, canonical, og:image
seo_check.py runs after creation with exit code 0
No invented ratings or numbers in the JSON-LD

evals.prompt: Seit drei Wochen sind unsere Google-Klicks um 40 % eingebrochen. Wo fange ich an?
evals.expected_output: Ordered diagnosis from references/measurement.md: verify the drop in Search Console vs analytics, date and shape, impressions vs CTR, segment vs site-wide, manual actions, deployment history (noindex, robots, canonical, CDN), Google update calendar, competition, seasonality. Asks for Search Console access or data rather than guessing a cause.
expectations: Follows the nine-step traffic-drop order and does not jump to content advice
Distinguishes impressions drop from CTR drop
Checks for manual actions and deployment changes before algorithm updates
References the 2025–2026 core/spam update dates as a check, not as the assumed cause
Offers to run crawl_check.py and seo_check.py against the live origin

evals.prompt: Unser Friseursalon in Hildesheim soll bei 'Friseur Hildesheim' besser gefunden werden. Sollen wir für jeden Stadtteil eine Seite machen?
evals.expected_output: Local SEO guidance: Google Business Profile as the main lever (category, name as on signage, hours, photos, reviews without incentives), NAP consistency incl. Impressum, HairSalon JSON-LD, one location page; rejects per-district pages as doorway abuse.
expectations: Rejects one page per district and names doorway abuse as the reason
Puts the Google Business Profile before on-site changes
States the review policy: asking allowed, incentives and gating forbidden
Recommends HairSalon (LocalBusiness subtype) JSON-LD from assets/jsonld/localbusiness.json with matching NAP
Mentions Impressum and NAP consistency as trust signals

evals.prompt: Wir hosten auf Cloudflare Workers mit SPA-Fallback. Google zeigt in der Search Console 'Soft 404' für hunderte URLs. Warum?
evals.expected_output: Explains that not_found_handling single-page-application serves index.html with 200 for unknown paths, that this is a soft 404, and gives the fix (404-page mode or Worker route returning status 404), plus verification via crawl_check.py soft-404 probe.
expectations: Identifies the SPA fallback 200 as the root cause
Gives a concrete configuration or Worker code fix
Recommends crawl_check.py to verify the probe returns 404
Mentions checking Cloudflare bot settings since Googlebot may also be affected by 2025–2026 defaults

evals.prompt: Prüfe bitte evals/fixtures/good für https://agrarmonitor.example und sag mir, ob wir live gehen können.
evals.expected_output: Runs seo_check.py with --base-url, reports 0 errors / 0 warnings, states what the script cannot judge (content quality, live status codes, CWV) and lists the remaining post-deploy checks rather than declaring everything perfect.
expectations: Runs the script and reports exit code 0
Does not overclaim: names that content quality and live crawl checks are separate steps
Lists post-deploy checks: crawl_check.py on the origin, Search Console URL Inspection, Bing IndexNow
Does not invent findings to fill the report
